title: $300 Google Cloud free trial credits for new builders
discount_summary: $300 in credits for eligible new Google Cloud users.
ai_summary: Good starter credit for builders testing hosted AI, storage, databases, and deployment workflows. Check billing settings before launching paid resources.

title: GitHub Student Developer Pack with cloud and dev tool perks
discount_summary: Bundle of developer, cloud, domain, and learning perks for verified students.
ai_summary: One of the highest-signal free bundles for student builders. Best for early projects that need hosting, domains, monitoring, and learning credits.

title: Vercel Hobby plan for personal projects and prototypes
discount_summary: Free hosting tier for personal, non-commercial projects.
ai_summary: Useful for fast prototypes and landing pages. Teams and commercial usage should review the Pro plan limits before relying on the free tier.

title: Cloudflare developer platform free tiers for Workers and storage
discount_summary: Free tiers across Workers and several developer platform services.
ai_summary: Strong option for globally distributed apps and automation. Review per-product limits if combining Workers, KV, R2, D1, and Queues.

title: Resend free email API tier for early projects
discount_summary: Free email sending tier for developers building transactional email.
ai_summary: Good fit for newsletters, waitlists, and transactional email in MVPs. Verify sending limits and domain setup before using it for production campaigns.

title: AppSumo AI and SaaS lifetime deal watchlist
discount_summary: Rotating lifetime and annual discounts for SaaS and AI tools.
ai_summary: High volume source for SaaS discounts, but deal quality varies. Best handled as a monitored source with editorial selection instead of blind auto-publishing.

title: OpenAI business workspace credit promotions watch
discount_summary: Workspace credit promotions occasionally appear for eligible business customers.
ai_summary: Worth monitoring because credits can be valuable, but eligibility and dates change quickly. Keep as review-only unless an official current promo page is verified.

title: beehiiv newsletter platform creator plan watch
discount_summary: Newsletter platform with occasional creator and partner promotions.
ai_summary: Relevant for builders launching newsletters. Publish only when a specific discount or partner credit is verified.

title: Supabase Free plan for builder databases and auth prototypes
discount_summary: Free plan for early projects with Postgres, auth, storage, APIs, and limited active projects.
ai_summary: Strong free database and auth stack for prototypes, landing products, and small builder apps. Watch project limits, inactivity pausing, and production upgrade costs before relying on it for paid users.

title: Railway free trial with starter hosting credit
discount_summary: Free trial for new users with a one-time credit grant and time-limited access to basic platform features.
ai_summary: Useful for testing app hosting, databases, and quick deployments. Account verification can affect the trial experience, and credits expire or revert to the free plan after the trial window.

title: Cursor Hobby free plan for AI coding assistant trials
discount_summary: Free AI coding plan with limited agent requests and tab completions.
ai_summary: Good low-friction way for developers to test Cursor before paying for Pro or Teams. Cursor warns that subscriptions should be purchased only through its official site.

title: Neon Free plan for serverless Postgres prototypes
discount_summary: Free serverless Postgres plan for learning, prototypes, and early builder projects with monthly compute and storage limits.
ai_summary: Strong official free Postgres option for builders testing SaaS products, AI apps, and internal tools. Treat it as a prototype-friendly plan and review compute, storage, restore, and production needs before scaling.

title: Netlify Free plan for builder web app hosting
discount_summary: Free hosting plan for deploying websites and web apps with custom domains, SSL, deploy previews, CDN, and monthly usage credits.
ai_summary: Good zero-cost deployment path for side projects, landing pages, and early SaaS interfaces. Watch monthly credit usage and plan limits before routing high-traffic or commercial production workloads.

title: Sentry Developer free monitoring plan for solo builders
discount_summary: Free developer plan for solo builders with error monitoring, tracing, email alerts, and limited included usage.
ai_summary: Useful for solo developers who need basic production error visibility without starting on a paid observability plan. Review event quotas, one-user limits, and upgrade pricing before adding a larger team.

title: Upstash Free plan for Redis-backed builder apps
discount_summary: Free serverless Redis plan for prototypes and hobby projects with included database, command, storage, and bandwidth limits.
ai_summary: Useful for builders adding queues, rate limits, sessions, caching, and small Redis-backed features without paying upfront. Review command, storage, bandwidth, and database limits before using it for production traffic.

title: GitHub Copilot Free plan for AI coding trials
discount_summary: Free AI coding assistant plan with limited completions and chat requests for developers testing Copilot.
ai_summary: Good low-friction option for developers comparing AI coding assistants before paying for Pro or Business. Watch monthly completion and chat limits, and separate personal use from organization policy requirements.

title: GitLab Free plan for private repos and builder DevOps workflows
discount_summary: Free GitLab SaaS plan for individuals and small teams with private repositories and limited included storage and CI/CD resources.
ai_summary: Relevant for builders who want private repos, issue tracking, and basic DevOps workflows without starting on a paid plan. Review repository storage, CI/CD usage, namespace, and team collaboration limits before scaling.

title: Groq free developer access for fast AI inference testing
discount_summary: Free developer access for testing Groq-hosted AI inference with rate limits and upgrade paths for production workloads.
ai_summary: Useful for builders comparing low-latency AI API providers or prototyping chat, agent, and automation workflows. Treat the free tier as a test environment and confirm current rate limits before production use.

title: Hugging Face Free plan for model discovery and AI prototypes
discount_summary: Free account for using Hugging Face community resources, models, datasets, and limited hosted AI tooling.
ai_summary: Relevant for builders researching open models, datasets, Spaces, and AI infrastructure before committing to paid compute. Review model licenses, hosted compute charges, and private collaboration limits before commercial use.

title: MongoDB Atlas free cluster for app prototypes
discount_summary: Free Atlas cluster option for learning, prototypes, and early application development with shared resource limits.
ai_summary: Solid database free tier for builders testing document-based apps, MVPs, and demo environments. Review storage, shared resource, backup, and region constraints before depending on it for production workloads.
